ns2:section.sectionText: Students will utilize a combination of online lessons in Moodle, Zoom-based discussion sections and office hours, and required e-book access. Two proctored hourly exams and a proctored final exam will be administered online through the online proctoring service Proctorio, requiring webcam and stable internet access. Students will need to attend one of three weekly online discussion sessions in Zoom on Fridays: either 10:00am-11:50am, 1:00pm-2:50pm, or 7:00pm-8:50pm.
